objective: First-time net interest credited to consolidation account after AIT and attributable transfer fees.
timing_method: Single measured execution per point using performance.now(); runtime is observational and runner-dependent.

metric_definitions.actual_duration_days: Elapsed simulation days until achievement or the strategy's valid stopping boundary.
metric_definitions.days_to_achievement: Elapsed days only for achieved goals; null when not achieved.
metric_definitions.credited_interest_per_day_lkr: Credited net interest divided by actual elapsed simulation days; descriptive, not an investment yield.
metric_definitions.target_attainment_pct: Credited net interest at stop divided by target; values below 100% indicate an unmet target.
metric_definitions.fees_pct_of_credited_interest: Transfer fees divided by credited net interest; null when no credited interest exists.
